headline: Moeve Agrees to Sell Algerian Oil and Gas Assets to Pertamina
summary: Spanish energy firm Moeve has agreed to sell its upstream oil and gas assets in Algeria to units of Indonesia's state energy firm Pertamina, marking its exit from the upstream business globally.
why: Moeve, majority owned by Abu Dhabi's Mubadala, is restructuring its portfolio as it transitions toward sustainable energy.

impacts.name: Moeve
impacts.why: Moeve is selling its upstream assets in Algeria as part of its global upstream exit.
